reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in our DM: he should keep **Wednesday 11 Nov at 15:30** free for the Bittern call.

- **Where that comes from:** On 14 Oct, in this same DM, Hollis told me his standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team for the Bittern rollout had moved to Wednesdays at 15:30. That message is the only record I found of the time. I found nothing saying it has changed since.
- **Not on the calendar:** I checked his calendar for 9–15 Nov and there's nothing booked. He'd said no action was needed back then, so the call was never added. My reply tells him to block the time himself, or offers to add it for him.

I only used what Hollis can see himself: his own DM with me, his calendar and #central-team, which he belongs to. Nothing from this DM was shared anywhere else.
